value.rationale: The four primitive connectives motivate asking what their total observational information is. The result classifies all unrestricted finite-chain relations modulo all-valuations/all-depth equivalence, supplies a provably minimal sparsification for every size, proves every primitive is independent, and counts every individual equivalence fiber exactly. It goes beyond raw relation counting and provides reusable canonicalization and finite semantic benchmarks.
